exposure: inter-pregnancy interval of less than 24 months
cohort: 116 pregnant females in Lahore, Pakistan, who gave birth to preterm babies with a gestational age between 20-37 weeks.
finding: Several factors including multi-gravidity, previous history of abortion, intrauterine death, infertility, previous cesarean section, short interpregnancy interval, urinary tract infections, genital tract infections, anemia, singleton pregnancy, and cephalic fetal presentation were significantly associated with preterm births.
mod_finding: Previous cesarean section was significantly associated with preterm birth.
